_comment: The two axes of the matrix, plus the tier legend. Wording comes from the final report, Appendix B (Tables B2 and B3) and Appendix E (Table E1). If you change wording here, change it in the workbook too.

autonomyLevels.name: Advise only
autonomyLevels.detail: Advise only: human decides and acts independently.

autonomyLevels.name: Prepare action
autonomyLevels.detail: Prepare action, human executes: agent drafts; human signs, sends or files.

autonomyLevels.name: Approved execution
autonomyLevels.detail: Execute low-risk actions with approval: agent acts only after approval of that specific action.

autonomyLevels.name: Bounded autonomy
autonomyLevels.detail: Execute bounded workflows autonomously: no per-action approval, within reversible, capped or allowlisted limits.

autonomyLevels.name: Open autonomy
autonomyLevels.detail: Execute high-impact actions autonomously: no approval; action may be irreversible or high-stakes.

impactClasses.name: Negligible
impactClasses.detail: Incorrect information produced before anyone acts on it.

impactClasses.name: Limited
impactClasses.detail: Effect stays within the affected system.

impactClasses.name: Significant
impactClasses.detail: Correction possible, but the effect reached the user.

impactClasses.name: Critical
impactClasses.detail: Financial or judicial consequences such as refunds, sentencing or filings relied upon.

riskLegend.label: Tier 1 — Permitted
riskLegend.note: Standard safeguards, monitoring and a named owner.

riskLegend.label: Tier 3 — Restricted
riskLegend.note: Formal assurance, approval or verified sign-off before deployment.

riskLegend.label: Tier 4 — Unacceptable as configured
riskLegend.note: Redesign, reduce autonomy or impact, or change the operating envelope, then reassess.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of risks
auditCategories.detail: Risk assessment, impact, classification assumptions, affected systems and stops.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of control design
auditCategories.detail: Policies, guardrails, workflow boundaries, permissions, limits and monitoring.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of control effectiveness
auditCategories.detail: Test results, monitoring evidence, exception handling and control failure tests.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of approval & oversight
auditCategories.detail: Human-in-the-loop configuration, approver authority, approval logs and exception approvals.

auditCategories.name: Evidence of resilience & recovery
auditCategories.detail: Rollback tests, failover evidence, incident response and recovery ownership.
